tha-ap364:1.1: Kekkhārupupphiya.] Yāmā devā idhāgantvā Gotamaṃ sirivacchasaṃ / kekkhārupupphaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap364:2.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap364:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kekkhārupupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
